I'd like to start today's session by introducing our most
unique exhibit: our rooftop sculpture garden! ® Every now
and then you'll be assigned this tour, so you'll need to
become familiar with the sculptures on our roof. *Here-let
me pass around a fact sheet with information on each
sculpture. Now— O museum visitors need to buy a special
pass to see this exhibit, so please remember to collect all
passes before you start the tour.
